_comment: marble_bars: Map 2's start/finish gate, the marble answer to Map 1's hell-rock rock_bars and a DROP-IN for it -- 10.6 m wide (local X across the lane), 8.5 m tall, 0.5 m deep (local Z along the lane), origin at the base centre, y=0 the ground, so the scene swaps the model and changes nothing else. An IRON PORTCULLIS IN A MARBLE FRAME, built out of the rotunda's own architecture: a socle to 0.85 at the full depth, a ledge where the screen sets back 0.12 (the rotunda's pilasters stand mb.PILASTER_PROUD 0.45 off a 3 m wall; a 0.5 m gate affords 0.12, the one number this model interprets), fluted pilaster jambs on mb.PILASTER_W 1.0 with marble returns, a 6.0 x 6.2 m mouth under a SEMICIRCULAR head of radius 3.0 in mb.HEAD_SEG 6 segments crowning at 7.20, and a cornice 7.70 .. 8.50 in marble_wall_build._cornice's own order -- soffit shade, front in three band, top in three shade. In the mouth hang 12 vertical bars of the cell bars' own iron, 0.13 m square (2 * mb.BAR_HW), at a 0.342 m pitch, with 3 horizontal cross-bars at 2.0 / 3.0 / 4.0: no gap anywhere is wider than 0.342, under rock_bars' guaranteed 0.38. ONE CLOSED CONTIGUOUS MESH: the bars' feet are cut out of the sill and the cross-bars' ends out of the jamb reveals, marble_wall_build._sill style, and every bar's head is cut out of the head soffit on the soffit's OWN polyline, so stone and iron share those edges and the arch closes on the iron with no lens of daylight. mb.audit: components 1, boundary 0, doubled 0, over 0, degenerate 0, duplicate positions 0; Euler 590 - 2076 + 1384 = -102, genus 52, which is exactly the 13 x 4 openings the grid makes and not one more. One textured material (marble's packed 256 px atlas + emissive), one UV set, no skin, no animation. MarbleBarsCollision is one box per real solid -- socle, cornice, two pilasters, two jamb margins, the spandrel, a box per vertical bar and a box per cross-bar -- shipped as a `-colonly` node; Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn. max_tris 1600: the visual mesh is 1384 tris, of which the iron is 844 (the 12 uprights are split at every cross-bar edge so the cross-bars' ends can close their side faces) and the mouth's cut sill, reveals and soffit 262.
